scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with explicit equality conditions; standalone reproducibility tests are supportive finite experiments, not an exhaustive certification. No independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Closed-form theorem for a fixed star graph, all positive linear edge costs and stationary independent incidence-row Kaczmarz. The Kaczmarz certificate is worst-direction one-step mean-square contraction per expected work; no claim about exact runtime, adaptive strategies, or general graphs. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: A square-root price-dominance transition for optimal weighted-star connectivity and incidence-row sampling
